 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-openclaw-luna6-medium-rnd0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u091/system/state/workspace/programs/task-43fa00f5.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    # Compare each marked color's vertical run length below and above the
    # horizontal separator; output the color whose run grows more.
    sep = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 5 for v in row))
    above, below = grid[:sep], grid[sep + 1:]
    colors = [c for c in {v for row in grid for v in row} if c not in (0, 5)]
    def count(rows, color):
        return sum(v == color for row in rows for v in row)
    chosen = max(colors, key=lambda c: count(below, c) - count(above, c))
    return [[chosen, chosen], [chosen, chosen]]
"
}
